purpose: Canonical private user JSON and shared three-cat self-care game data; all active currency data fully repriced and normalized.

fileRoles.jasper/self_care.json: Jasper private physical/mental support, goals, encouragement and full life-impact support context
fileRoles.jasper/tasks.json: Jasper current individual tasks + archived legacy task definitions
fileRoles.jasper/shop.json: Jasper current fictional rewards shop + legacy items
fileRoles.jasper/life_events.json: Jasper private event templates; no dates invented
fileRoles.jasper/cats.json: Jasper-specific relationships and state for all three cats
fileRoles.william/self_care.json: William private physical/mental support, goals, encouragement and full life-impact support context
fileRoles.william/tasks.json: William current individual tasks + archived legacy task definitions
fileRoles.william/shop.json: William current fictional rewards shop + legacy items
fileRoles.william/life_events.json: William private event templates; no dates invented
fileRoles.william/cats.json: William-specific relationships and state for all three cats
fileRoles.shared/tasks.json: Shared household/cat care tasks and takeover rules
fileRoles.shared/shop.json: Shared rewards catalog (unpriced legacy tiers marked as suggestions)
fileRoles.shared/cats.json: Canonical Onyx, Callie, Harvey personalities, game behavior, safety boundaries, full family dossier
fileRoles.shared/currency.json: Canonical four-denomination conversion, normalization and validation rules
fileRoles.shared/game_rules.json: Finch-inspired optional self-care and current game mechanics
fileRoles.shared/manifest.json: This manifest, source information and validation

privacy.IMPORTANT: Private user folders contain sensitive physical and mental health and distressing life-event data. Keep them on authenticated, owner-scoped storage only.
privacy.recommendedHosting: Backend-only, authenticated profile-scoped storage for private files. Public game files must exclude privateSupportContext.
privacy.sharedCatsIncludesFamilyAnecdotes: The shared cats file embeds the supplied family personality dossier, which includes personal family/health anecdotes. Restrict the shared folder to both authenticated users, not the general public.

currencyPolicy: Every price and reward is stored in a four-field normalized denomination object: platinum (unlimited), gold (0–9), silver (0–9), copper (0–9). Exchange rates are 10:1 per step; no raw copper totals or historical reward amounts are stored.
canonicalPolicy: Current prices/rewards only; no retired values. Preserve latest life events, Jasper diabetes update, shop repricing, and 18-file three-folder structure.

integration.backendCompatibilityNote: Existing code expecting a single-unit numeric amount must be adapted to the four-denomination objects before deploying these data files. No deployed backend or game code has been modified.
